revision_summary: Two minor wrong_ts quote errors must be corrected: (1) script_coverage[2].address_homeowner quote 'So it's still empty lot, but I know the home is built. It's a single family. Right?' is timestamped 00:20 but actually occurs at ~02:33-02:37; fix the ts. (2) script_coverage[11].appointment_set customer_quote 'Afternoon. After 04:00 is fine.' is timestamped 03:51 but actually occurs at ~04:18-04:20; fix the ts. Additionally: (a) relabel script_coverage[7] section id from 'tax_credit_qualifier' to something matching qualifiers.credit_qualifier — the current label misapplies a different schema concept (tax credit disclosure) to the credit-score threshold question. (b) Add a flagged moment for the co-owner/son-on-title item (02:44-02:56): the son is a co-owner but is never included in or mentioned for the appointment, which is a direct miss against protocols.adult_child_decision_maker; this should surface in cherry_pick_moments and/or handoff_brief.unresolved_concerns rather than being left as a neutral null in observed_outcome. (c) Soften the handoff_brief's prescriptive language about the closer needing to use 'estimated usage or a placeholder figure' — this tactical suggestion isn't schema-grounded and risks violating handoff_brief_discipline's rule against locking the closer's approach; rephrase as an open flag rather than a directive. (d) Consider surfacing the transparent map/system-limitation admission at 01:56-02:02 as a positive knowledge_gap_handling example per analysis_directives. These are targeted fixes; the overall trajectory read, outcome classification (booked), and bill-anchor/button-up gap findings are well-supported and should be retained as-is.
